efficient_exact_options: Batch/stream contiguous blocks containing complete trees; retain all sampled leaves and native vertices.
Reuse observation-only structural recipes, keep tree-sequence edge-diff representation, and bucket complete-tree levels for GPU batching.
Use exact activation checkpoint/recomputation and CPU offload with bidirectional boundary states; never detach/reset or truncate history.
Same-partition affine recurrences admit associative(alpha,b) scans; arbitrary cross-event transport products can densify toH-by-H.
Changing one edge can alter upward ancestry and global outside states; edge_diffs alone does not give O(edge changes) neural work.
Compress occupied event cells/ragged layouts to remove padding; retain per-hold forcing when trees differ despite an unchanged cut.

lemma.limits: Contraction concerns carry alone. Learned forcing/output maps and complete predictor are not certified contractive. If alpha depends on the learned state x, the fixed-operator norm is not a global Lipschitz bound.
